affected_subject.reason: Identifies EloCalculator.battleElo and its eloA/eloB update logic.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete condition: battleElo applies change/negative from ratingChange with inverted sign handling.

summary: Fragments identify the affected battleElo function, the inverted sign-application trigger, the resulting wrong-direction rating changes, and the expected-vs-actual Elo relation, sufficient to attempt formalization.
